newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks were widely higher at Friday's open after a surprisingly weak September payrolls report quelled inflation worries and sent bond prices soaring.
The Dow industrials rose 12 points to 5,945 at the start of business. The NASDAQ Index rose 10 to 1,243 and the S&P Index was up two at 695.
The long bond was up 26/32 to yield 6.77 percent as Wall Street opened.
